metadata.description: Curated Fermi-surface Plotly traces extracted from uploaded scratch HTML. Keeps solid band-color mesh3d traces and optional first-Brillouin-zone line; removes vF/orbital-map traces, annotations, and Plotly layout controls.
metadata.note: These traces preserve the uploaded mesh geometry. Visual smoothing is handled in JS with lighting/opacity; true geometry smoothing requires higher-resolution source data.
